summary: Binance 被盗事件后，账户安全成为焦点：一项 EIP-8151 修订提议让通过 EIP-8476 永久关闭 7702 委托的 EOA 仍能使用 permit 签名，Ethlabs 周报强调 7702 本身没有被攻破。Frame Transaction（EIP-8141）合并一项 nonce 边界修复，属于破坏性变更。后量子方面，EIP-8479 提交，@ethereum 发布剑桥 PQ 研讨会视频。

items.topic: EIP-7702 委托的安全边界：永久退出与 permit 兼容
items.title: EIPs PR #12605：EIP-8151 把 0xef0200 退出标记视为合格 EOA
items.note: 16:01 提交。EIP-8151（Account Code Restricted ecRecover）目前只允许空代码或 `0xef0100 || delegate` 委托指示符的账户使用 `ecrecover`。如果和 EIP-8476 一起上线，选择退出 7702 的账户签的 permit 会返回空结果，与“只关闭委托能力、保留普通 EOA 能力”的本意矛盾。这个 PR 只把 EIP-8476 的标记加进合格集合。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12605: EIP-8151 treats the 0xef0200 opt-out marker as a qualifying EOA
items.note_en: Opened at 16:01. EIP-8151 (Account Code Restricted ecRecover) currently lets only accounts with empty code or a `0xef0100 || delegate` designator use `ecrecover`. If it shipped alongside EIP-8476, permits signed by accounts that opted out of 7702 would return an empty result, which contradicts the intent of removing only the delegation ability while keeping normal EOA behavior. The PR simply adds the EIP-8476 marker to the qualifying set.
items.topic_en: The security boundary of EIP-7702 delegation: permanent opt-out and permit compatibility

items.topic: EIP-7702 委托的安全边界：永久退出与 permit 兼容
items.title: EIPs PR #12600：Add EIP-8476 Permanent EOA Delegation Opt-Out
items.note: 背景：EIPs PR #12600：Add EIP-8476 Permanent EOA Delegation Opt-Out（2026-10-30 提交）。账户代码写成精确标记后，未来的授权（包括清除授权）都会被拒绝；EVM 把标记当作空代码处理（`EXTCODESIZE` 为 0，`EXTCODEHASH` 为空代码哈希）。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12600: Add EIP-8476 Permanent EOA Delegation Opt-Out
items.note_en: Background: EIPs PR #12600: Add EIP-8476 Permanent EOA Delegation Opt-Out (opened 2026-10-30). Once the account code is set to the exact marker, every future authorization, including one that clears delegation, is rejected. The EVM treats the marker as empty code (`EXTCODESIZE` is 0 and `EXTCODEHASH` is the empty code hash).
items.topic_en: The security boundary of EIP-7702 delegation: permanent opt-out and permit compatibility

items.topic: EIP-7702 委托的安全边界：永久退出与 permit 兼容
items.title: Ethlabs 第 19 周周报
items.note: 18:33 发布，引用 Derek Chiang 10-30 的说明：7702 本身没有被攻破，使用支持 7702 的钱包（MetaMask、Uniswap、Ambire 等）不必恐慌。Barnabé 预期链上会出现更多由新账户能力承载、由 agent 管理的限速和熔断机制。
items.note_en: Published at 18:33, quotes Derek Chiang's note from 10-30: 7702 itself was not compromised, and people using 7702-capable wallets (MetaMask, Uniswap, Ambire and others) do not need to panic. Barnabé expects more onchain rate limits and circuit breakers run by agents on top of the new account capabilities.

items.topic: EIP-8141 Frame Transaction：nonce 边界修复
items.title: EIPs PR #12603：Update EIP-8141 Transaction nonce check boundary
items.note: 18:20 合并。规范改为发送方 nonce 最大只接受 `MAX-1`，与 execution-specs 中 bogota 分叉的 frame transaction 实现一致。PR 标注为 Bugfix、Breaking Change、需要实现方 Action Required。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12603: Update EIP-8141 Transaction nonce check boundary
items.note_en: Merged at 18:20. The spec now accepts a sender nonce of at most `MAX-1`, matching the frame transaction implementation for the bogota fork in execution-specs. The PR is labeled Bugfix, Breaking Change and Action Required for implementers.

summary_en: After the Binance theft, account security is the main thread. A revision to EIP-8151 would let EOAs that permanently disable 7702 delegation through EIP-8476 keep using permit signatures, and the Ethlabs weekly stresses that 7702 itself was not broken. Frame Transaction (EIP-8141) merged a breaking fix to its nonce boundary. On post-quantum work, EIP-8479 was submitted and @ethereum published video from the Cambridge PQ workshop.
